name: OBOS
verdict: Norwegian housing cooperative (OBOS BBL), owned by its more than half a million members. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Viking partner since 2018 (club partner page). Not on the 2026 home kit record: no source found names OBOS on the 2026 shirt (the club's 2021 renewal put OBOS on the shirt for three seasons). Member-owned cooperative (obos-boligbyggelag); no state owner, so 'none'.
